name: Dark Essence heals Blood Rituals allies when Bloodbolt is cast (#508)
contract: Dark Essence 680732 is a single aura 4 (SPELL_AURA_DUMMY) marker with BasePoints -1: 'Casting Cursed Form abilities or Bloodbolt will now heal allies affected by Blood Rituals for ${$681036m1+$681036ppl1+$BH*0.1} every $681036t1 sec for $681036d.' Every number is in 681036: aura 8 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL, BasePoints 29 / DieSides 5 / RealPointsPerLevel 2.0, Amplitude 1500, TargetA 22 (TARGET_SRC_CASTER) + TargetB 30 (TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ALLY), RadiusIndex 23. The only Spell.dbc row that triggers 681036 is 806945, a different 'Dark Essence' record that coa-obtainable --class 20 (222/222 identical between the shipped CharacterAdvancement.dbc and the live-client capture) reports as advancement=none, live_capture=False, so the obtainable talent healed nobody. Blood Rituals is 706623. 578305 is the Bloodbolt rank a level-80 character owns. The second player carries Blood Rituals; the third does not and is the control that proves the area selection is narrowed to Blood Rituals carriers, which the native area aura would ignore.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Blood Rituals on one ally only
No Dark Essence heal without the talent
The Blood Rituals ally receives Dark Essence
It ticks at 681036's own 1.5 second interval
An ally without Blood Rituals is not healed
